purpose: Exploratory native desktop UI overview boards

prompts.name: Terminal
prompts.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a high-fidelity design presentation board for BitChat Desktop, an independent Bitchat-compatible native desktop messenger for macOS, Windows and Linux. Flat straight-on desktop application windows, absolutely no laptops, phones, perspective, people, stock imagery or marketing website. A 3-column by 2-row board of six crisp large screens, each numbered and captioned beneath. Landscape 3:2 or wider, high resolution, readable short UI text, plenty of space between windows, consistent typography and component language. The six windows: 01 Mesh chat (#mesh channel, compact people sidebar, timestamps, calm message composer, nearby peers indicator); 02 Private conversation (peer Maya, encrypted and verified labels distinct, compact received/delivered state, attachment and voice actions); 03 People (Nearby, Across the bridge, Recent, Groups sections, transport and verification badges); 04 Location channels (mesh, block, neighborhood, city, region, country, compact geohash captions, location disclosure); 05 Settings (Connectivity, mesh bridge, Tor routing, private-message relay addresses, notification privacy, language and appearance, destructive panic wipe separated); 06 Identity verification (fingerprint comparison, a visibly illustrative QR pattern, copy fingerprint, show my code / scan code tabs). App title exactly 'BitChat Desktop'. Sample participants Maya, Arun, Youhana. No account signup, wallets, AI assistant, cloud subscription, massive rounded cards or decorative glass effects. These are sample mockups, never imply actual safety guarantees beyond explicit UI status. Each screen is a believable lightweight native UI, built with simple rows, vector icons, borders and native controls. Direction: TERMINAL. Preserve Bitchat's hacker character with near-black surfaces, warm off-white body text, precisely restrained phosphor green accent, subtle charcoal rules, Monaco/Menlo monospaced type, dense left-aligned IRC-style message log, square-to-small-radius controls. Professionally refined and readable, no neon glow. Board background dark graphite. Heading '01 / TERMINAL' and subtitle 'The familiar mesh, refined for desktop'.
